name: principle-prove-it-works
purpose: Verify task outputs against the real artifact before declaring completion.
triggers: After completing a task, before declaring done
inputs: task outputs and the real feature, process or stored value
Available inspection and execution tools and permissions
outputs: Direct observations and visible verification artifacts
Explicit unverified outputs when direct checks are unavailable
ordinaryExample: After a feature compiles, run the feature and read its actual stored value before declaring it complete.
capabilityLimits: Unavailable or denied direct checks leave the affected outputs unverified.
